verdict.rationale: Sardine documents AI agents that auto-clear false positives, do supporting research, and route higher-risk matches to analysts [18,21]. It also offers explainable scores [21], a case management workspace for reviewing alerts and resolving cases [26], and 'audit-ready' agentic AML ops [28]. Together these suggest the AI's decisions can be inspected and that their rationale is retained. No evidence documents a human explicitly overriding an agent's auto-clear or escalation decision while the original evidence and rationale stay intact, so this is only partial. Missing for 10: a documented override action on agent decisions, explicit preservation of the original evidence and rationale after an override (an audit trail or decision history), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
